'''Avers''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A fierce opponent of the Empire and patriot of his homeworld [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Imperial occupation]], he was ordered to aid the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in their [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] to retrieve a [[prototype cloaking device]], but Avers and his superior [[Nikollan Kord]] attempted to betray the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by stealing the prototype.
